title: 横向游戏大厅背景
intendedUse: 横向 H5 游戏大厅主背景；标题、游戏卡片、余额和按钮由界面单独渲染
prompt: Create a wide 3D casual-mobile-game lobby environment in the exact rendering style of the supplied visual reference: polished rounded game-art volumes, smooth teal enamel surfaces, warm ivory stone, restrained gold bevel trim, soft upper-left light, gentle contact shadows, clean simplified shapes. Show a welcoming stylized game-hall interior with a few broad arches and subtle table-inspired details at the outer edges. Keep the central 60 percent of the canvas calm, open, and low-detail for H5 game cards and controls. Keep the lower center open too. Use a shallow readable perspective; make it feel like a carefully crafted game illustration, not a real palace or travel vista.
negativePrompt: photorealism, realistic mountains, ocean, resort, palace photography, cinematic environment concept art, flat vector, watercolor, rough texture, tiny ornaments, excessive gold, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI screenshot, buttons, card ranks, people

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match only the stylized 3D rendering, teal/ivory/gold palette, smooth materials, bevel highlights and soft lighting. Do not copy the card medallion or icon composition.
